composition.order: native original-grid hard planes under stored application ownership -> confidence native-foreground compose -> total label projection
composition.priority: ascending(score,-packet_index), overwrite where native label>0; highest score wins, tie lower packet index
composition.OTHER: Preserve winning recognized native class before projection; mappedOTHER still overwrites lower-priority target
composition.native_BG: Transparent in the frozen native-positive composer; do not replace this with all-pixel overwrite
composition.Sapiens: Same rule on YOLO-mask-clipped native29 planes; native semantic classes are not person IDs

metrics.primary: Global 6x6 confusion, IoU each target, unweighted mean fixed4 targets (BG/OTHER excluded from mean but fully retained as negatives)
metrics.unit: ratios0..1; displays percent with unit explicit
metrics.aggregation: sum pixel confusion over identical population then ratio; never mean source IoUs or image means
metrics.zero_union: IoU=0 for fixed4 macro; union/support flags retained, not a successful prediction
secondary: C3 sensitivity mean hair/upper/lower, cannot replace four-target requirement
Q_C4_GT target-only per-GT-person mean with missedGT=0
matched C4 contamination and background leakage with numerator/denominator/null-when-empty
metrics.matching: Canonical geometry ordering (bbox y0,x0,y1,x1,area,sumY,sumX,packedmask bytes), maximize eligible mask-IoU cardinality then sumIoU; lexicographic canonical assignment among optima within1e-12; no semantic labels/scores used. Identical GT geometry falls back stableGT-ID; identical predgeometry falls back packetindex. Record alternative-optimum/identicalgeometry cases.
metrics.G_loc: Reconstruct from frozen Human_ids with nonempty extent on global valid domain; do not copy scalar17,520 without reconstruction binding
metrics.G_sem: number of GT people with at least one projectedtargetpixel on person domain; fixed across models; new materialized manifest required
metrics.person_Q: For matched eligible GTi, mean IoU over union of target classes present in GTi or paired prediction over full valid person domain; unmatched eligibleGT contributes0; sum/G_sem; no-target G_sem=0 givesnull
metrics.unmatched_predictions: ExtentFP plus global target FP where relevant; not directly charged in GT-onlyQ, soQ never sole overall-winner metric
metrics.semantic_empty_person: Retain valid extent and identity; maymatchTP; Q=0 if pairedGT has targets
metrics.strict_complete: 5000 unique IDs for fullcomparison with packet+GT+protocol/evaluator bindings and all artifacts verified; any unresolved failure/missing/invalid -> main scoresnull, retainedrow; pilot completion is separate6 IDs and cannot certify5000
metrics.matching_tie_precision: 1e-12 absolute sumIoU; thresholdinclusive>=.50/.75; GT-ID renaming invariant whenGTgeometrydistinct. IdenticalGTgeometry fallbackID can changeQ underIDrenaming; no unconditional invariance/permutation claim.
metrics.C3: Global mean only for classes2,3,4 from same6x6confusion; Faceclass1 remains valid negative. No Q_C3, no G_sem_C3 or second persondenominator.
